title: Taylor Glass Top Food Scale with Touch Control Buttons, 11 lb Capacity, Black
description:
About this item
QUALITY AND PRECISION: Taylor has been making precision products for kitchen measurement for over 150 years, using only the highest quality components for accurate weighing. Measure precisely up to 11lb x 0.1oz / 5kg x 0.001kg / 5000g x 1g.
SLEEK DESIGN IS EASY TO CLEAN: The glass is backpainted in black to look sleek, while the material is naturally stain resistant. The smooth touch buttons won't collect dirt.
CONVENIENT FEATURES: Add and weigh tare allows multiple ingredients to be weighed in one container. Save battery life with the auto shut off feature.
EXTRA LARGE DIGITAL READOUT: See the weight at ease with the 0.75" digital screen.
BATTERY INCLUDED: 2 AAA batteries are included.
One (1) year limited warranty

reviews_5s:
This kitchen scale is very useful. It has multiple weight measurements that are easy to cycle through. I mostly use grams because I measure my yarn with it, but it's very good for food as well. You can tare it, meaning that you set the scale to zero. This is useful when you, say, want to measure the weight of flour. You would set an empty bowl or jar on the scale, tare it, and it would set to zero. So now you can get an accurate reading of the flour itself without the weight of the bowl in the way.

I believe the quality is good for the price, and it even comes with batteries! I very much recommend this scale!Great easy to use scale. Makes baking sourdough so much easier.This scale works out perfectly for me for weighing out my meal prep and protein drinks..I had another Taylor scale that lasted a long time but eventually died. I got this one based on the reviews and it’s a serious upgrade. The top is glass and looks great and easy to clean. It’s easy to go through a variety of weight options- oz, g, fl oz, ml. It’s also easy to clean. Great value for the money and very accurate.I make bread in a bread machine. It requires great precision when weighing ingredients. Put in a few grams too much water in the machine and the top of the loaf will collapse. I owned a similar Taylor kitchen scale for several years before I accidentally dropped it on my porcelain-tiled kitchen floor, shattering the glass. Up to that unfortunate point, the scale worked perfectly well daily. I expect this similar Taylor kitchen scale to be just as good. I'll try not to drop it on the floor again.I needed a new kitchen scale. It’s accurate and easy to use.This new scale works really well. I like the feature that you can put an empty vessel on the scale and set the scale to zero. I purchased the sale on Nov 6th 2024 , the sale stopped working today April 9th 2025 , not very good product, now i am without a scale this scale only lasted five monthsI was making 2 batches of sourdough bread and needed a replacement scale, fast. I purchased this scale and had it delivered the same day. It worked perfect for the first batch of bread but 1.5 hours later when making the second batch, it would not stop adjusting from g to kg when the weight became over a certain amount. This is unacceptable when a recipe is written for grams only.
Had it not worked perfectly 1.5 hours prior, I would have thought the scale wasn't designed to hold a gram weight. But it worked as expected on the first batch of bread so the scale was defective. I returned it for a refund and purchased one that had only 5 star ratings, an OXO Good Grips 11-Pound Stainless Steel Food Scale with Pull-Out Display sold on Amazon, $55.95, and I also bought the 2yr warranty.

0 for 2!
Purchase 1: I purchased one of these yesterday at a local Kroger. The power/tare button was unresponsive - wouldn't zero and wouldn't power off. It is getting returned.
Purchase 2: This is the only brand carried by Kroger, so I tried Target today. Target only carries Taylor scales. I debated whether I would strike lead twice with this product and reluctantly purchased another. I took it home, inserted the batteries and found that the unit button didn't work. This is getting returned too.
Purchase 3: I bought a lottery ticket thinking my luck would even out. I didn't win.

I won't by this product or any other Taylor product again.Does not weigh grams, very disappointing.Bought this scale at Publix, but it is the exact same model. As the review title states, this is the worst scale I have ever used. It is slow to react to changes in weight, inaccurate, and the "buttons" are unresponsive. I used this scale to measure coffee for use with pour overs, and for that purpose, it is next to worthless. Perhaps, if you only want to weight out a general portion size of food, this scale would work fine. For weighing out a portion of ground coffee, this scale lagged about 5-10 seconds before responding to the added weight, causing me to pour more than was needed. If I very carefully weighed the exact same thing again, the measured weight would vary between 5-10 grams in both directions. The off/tare button was so unresponsive to touch, I could touch it, wait, touch it again, wait, and so on and so forth for 10 repetitions and the scale would not even begin to tare. Because I had already thrown away the receipt and box, I ended up trashing the scale in frustration.

There are better kitchen scales from generic Chinese companies on Amazon that are more accurate and even include timers for the exact same price. The only thing this scale is good for is looking like a scale, and since the area with the buttons is black and has a glossy finish making it into a dusty fingerprint magnet, I wouldn't even use it for that.
